review.why: Draft honest, specific answers to job-application form fields from the candidate's CV and the job posting.
review.summary: Seven question types (experience, why this company, portfolio, technical skills, tell us about yourself, behavioral, opinion), each with a format, rules, length targets and before/after examples. Answers come as copy-paste blocks.
strengths: Clear format and rules for each question type, with a length target per field.
Insists on real projects and honest years or ratings; warns against repeating the job posting or padding.
Asks for the CV and the job description before writing instead of guessing.
cautions: Examples come from one engineer's projects; answers must use the user's own facts.
Tuned to technical roles on English-language application systems; no guidance for salary, work-authorization or diversity questions.
Instruction-only skill: no scripts or form integration, nothing is submitted for the user.
